finalizeElection().notice: Finalizes election and transfers ownership to winner

getCandidates().notice: Get all candidates in current election

getTokensOf(string).notice: Get tokens held by a user

getZoneMembers(uint256).notice: Get zone members for a specific zone

removeFromExterior(string).notice: Removes a member from their exterior zone

reward(address,uint256).notice: Main reward function supporting ETH and ERC20

setSteepness(uint256).notice: Sets the steepness parameter for exterior distribution

startElection().notice: Start a new election (resets previous election state)

syncAll(uint256,uint256,uint256,uint256,.notice: Sync all Bundle parameters in a single transaction

vote(string,string).notice: Member casts their vote for a candidate
